|strategy=By [mailto:jediknight@decipher.com Justin Pakes, Jedi Knight]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/dark/small/navytroopervesden.html</ref>

[[Navy Trooper Vesden]] Not only another character for your ISB deck, but insert protection to boot. Basically works such that if Vesden is at a Scomp Link when the opponents [[Never Tell Me The Odds]] comes to the top of your reserve Deck, you can add 3 to the destiny value of one of your characters at every location.

For example, if you have [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] and [[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]] at one site, Ozzel and a [[Biker Scout Trooper]] at another, and another [[Biker Scout Trooper]] at a Scomp Link location, then the destiny value of your three lowest destiny characters is a terrible 0+1+1 = 2. Compare that to your opponents 3 droids and you look like losing a fair few Force!

Add Vesden to support that lonely [[Biker Scout Trooper]] and your lowest three now total 1+3+3 = 7! That's 5 Force saved. Pack a [[Torture]] or two and you'll have those insert decks on the run.
|rulings=* Vesden may respond to [[Never Tell Me The Odds]] only once (not a separate response for each location).<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Navy%20Trooper%20Vesden</ref>
* If Vesden responds, Dark chooses one of their characters at every location to 'shield'. Ignore any locations where Dark has no characters.
